verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an official MCP integration that connects a Puzzle account to Claude for conversational access to live financial data, and markets plain-English Q&A over the ledger, such as cash trends and runway. That is the core of agent-grounded questioning. However, an affordability-style answer is never shown, and the docs do not say the agent pulls ledger data through the public API, which is described as built for platform-to-platform integrations. missing for 10: documented affordability or scenario answers ("can we afford X?"), explicit evidence that the agent queries live ledger data via the API, details of which data and tools the MCP exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
